environment.description: Same CLI tool deployed on EC2. The PostgreSQL role 'webhook_validator' was provisioned via Terraform module 'pg_restricted_roles' with a default privilege set that includes pg_read_all_data predefined role membership only. The role has no explicit GRANT for INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE on any relation. Additionally, a pg_hba.conf entry restricts this role to connections from 127.0.0.1 only. The instance runs IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 and PUT response hop limit enforced, meaning the metadata token acquisition requires a PUT with X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header that cannot traverse through urllib's HTTP redirect following. Instance has no IAM role attached (empty instance profile).

config.db_explicit_grants: GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE webhooks TO webhook_validator; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO webhook_validator; -- no DML grants
